hero.imageAlt: Laxsik Ecolodge among the rice terraces of Lao Chai, Sa Pa
hero.location: Lao Chai, Sa Pa, Lao Cai, Vietnam

introduction.title: At the doorstep of Sa Pa nature
introduction.description: A peaceful retreat in Lao Chai Valley, surrounded by terraced fields, mountain air and the living culture of Sa Pa. Every stay brings guests closer to the landscape and the rhythm of the local community.

rooms.title: Rooms & Suites
rooms.description: Explore our current rooms, images and nightly rates.

wellness.title: Laxsik Wellness
wellness.description: A quiet wellness space surrounded by rice terraces, created for movement, rest and unhurried moments in the mountain air.

restaurant.title: Muong Hoa Restaurant
restaurant.description: A warm dining room overlooking the valley, where each meal brings together local ingredients and the flavours of the Northwest.

cuisine.title: H'Mong cuisine with chef
cuisine.description: Cook alongside our local team and discover the ingredients, techniques and stories behind H'Mong cuisine.

trekking.title: Trekking tour
trekking.description: Walk through Muong Hoa Valley, terraced fields and mountain villages with the landscape of Sa Pa unfolding around you.

spa.title: Po Mu Spa
spa.description: Slow down with restorative treatments inspired by Red Dao herbal traditions and the calm rhythm of the mountains.

wedding.title: Wedding on the clouds
wedding.description: Celebrate against a mountain panorama with an intimate setting shaped by flowers, local craft and the beauty of Sa Pa.

gallery.imageAlt: Terraced rice fields in Sa Pa
gallery.description: A glimpse of the landscape, local culture and quiet moments around Laxsik Ecolodge.

1.title: CHECK-IN/OUT TIMES
1.description: Check-in time: 3:00 PM. Check-out time: 12:00 PM.

2.title: EARLY ARRIVALS AND LATE DEPARTURES
2.description: For guaranteed early access, we recommend booking the previous night. For a guaranteed late departure, reserve an additional night. Otherwise, we will gladly store your bags and make our fitness facilities available for you to freshen up.

3.title: CREDIT CARDS
3.description: American Express, Visa, Master Card and JCB.

4.title: CANCEL BOOKING
4.description: Reservations can be cancelled no later than 48 hours before the scheduled check-in time. Cancellation is unavailable after this deadline.

banner.imageAlt: Muong Hoa Restaurant overlooking the valley
banner.title: MUONG HOA RESTAURANT
banner.description: Muong Hoa Restaurant offers a refined dining experience inspired by the rich flavors and fresh ingredients of Northwest Vietnam. Set against the scenery of Muong Hoa Valley, the restaurant combines traditional Vietnamese cuisine with a modern touch.

services.title: SERVICES
services.empty: No dining services are currently available.

banner.title: LAXSIK SPA
banner.description: A peaceful sanctuary surrounded by nature, where traditional wellness treatments and modern relaxation come together. Every massage and restorative therapy is designed to release tension, refresh your body and restore calm.

services.title: SPA SERVICES
services.empty: No spa services are currently available.

Contact.heroDescription: We are here to help with your stay, the journey to Lao Chai and any questions before you arrive.
Contact.heroAlt: Laxsik Ecolodge illuminated in the mountains at night
Contact.sectionEyebrow: Find your way to the valley
Contact.sectionTitle: We look forward to hearing from you
Contact.sectionDescription: Laxsik Ecolodge is set among the rice terraces of Lao Chai. Use the map for directions or reach our team directly by phone and email.
Contact.mapTitle: Location of Laxsik Ecolodge on Google Maps
Contact.address: Lao Chai, Sa Pa, Lao Cai, Vietnam
Contact.responseNote: For the quickest response, please call our hotline. Email enquiries are welcomed at any time.

hero.imageAlt: Muong Hoa Valley rice terraces surrounded by mountains
hero.title: Discover Sa Pa, one story at a time
hero.description: Walk beyond the familiar views and spend time with the landscapes, traditions and people that give Muong Hoa Valley its rhythm.

list.title: Journeys shaped by the valley
list.description: From a gentle village stroll to a full-day highland challenge, these routes reveal Sa Pa through forest paths, waterfalls, rice terraces and local communities.
list.loadError: We could not load the journeys right now.
list.empty: New seasonal journeys are being prepared. Please ask our local team for the best routes during your stay.

notes.title: A closer way to meet Sa Pa
notes.description: The most memorable moments are often unscheduled: a conversation beside a field, tea shared in a family home or mist lifting from the terraces.

season.title: Season-led routes
season.description: Paths and views change with the rice season, rain and village activity, so every journey feels slightly different.

local.title: Local perspective
local.description: Experiences are shaped around people, traditions and everyday life rather than a checklist of attractions.

pace.title: A comfortable pace
pace.description: There is time to stop, talk, take photographs and enjoy the landscape without rushing from place to place.

practical.title: A few useful notes

items.shoes: Wear shoes with reliable grip for terrace and village paths.
items.rain: Bring a light rain layer; mountain weather can change quickly.
items.photos: Ask before photographing people, homes or ceremonies.
items.routes: Routes may be adjusted to suit weather and trail conditions.

practical.imageAlt: Rice terraces and villages across Muong Hoa Valley
practical.footer: Routes are introductions rather than fixed itineraries. Our local team can share the most suitable seasonal options during your stay.
